exposure: Letrozole co-treatment in an antagonist protocol for IVF/ICSI
cohort: Infertile women with polycystic ovary syndrome undergoing IVF/ICSI.
finding: Letrozole co-treatment for infertile women with PCOS undergoing IVF reduced the number of retrieved oocytes and increased large follicles, but resulted in comparable live birth rates and no significant differences in obstetrical and neonatal complications.
